utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have we got enough volunteers yet, or do we still need more help?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think we may still need a few more hands, unless the list says otherwise. Bring it by and I’ll help however I can with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—do we have a sign-up list, or should I start asking around for a few more volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still haven’t heard the exact drop-off spot—Tess said by the community hall, right? If that’s changed, I’d appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure — it’s the repair drive for tools and spare parts, and Tess said drop-offs are by the community hall. If you hear any change, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the confirmed time and drop-off spot, so I don’t want to guess. As soon as I have it, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s still on, just waiting for the exact time and drop-off spot? Let me know when it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, exactly — it’s still on, I’m just waiting for the exact time and drop-off spot. I’ll let you know as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on the exact location for the repair drive—do you know where it’s set up?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—I’m not sure of the exact spot yet. I can check and get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane—please let me know as soon as you confirm the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. That should be easier to work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s better for me, Faye. Sunday at the community center works—I’ll plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll plan around Sunday at the community center too and let the school know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ve been spreading the word, and I can keep the repair drive on everyone’s radar if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Jules—thanks. Just keep folks posted, and let me know if anything still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll keep everyone posted and flag anything that still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s the repair drive for tools, spare parts, and repair supplies, with drop-offs by the community hall. I’m spreading the word around the block and putting up a few invites too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — tools, spare parts, and repair supplies by the community hall. I can help spread the word, and let me know if there’s anything I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah — that’d be a big help. If you can, bring any extra tools or spare parts you’ve got, and I’ll keep handing out invites around the block.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly just the main item you need me to handle for the repair drive—what should I focus on?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you handle the toolbox pickup? That’s the main thing I still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can handle the toolbox pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s at the community center on Sunday now, not the front porch. I’ll keep an eye out for tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Rosa — the community center on Sunday works. I’ll get everything else organized for then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — thank you, Cleo. I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and keep an eye out for tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? It’s really coming together nicely—people are dropping off tools and spare parts over by the community hall. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess—that’d be great. I’ll check by the community hall and see if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I'll keep listening around and let you know if I hear they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to a few folks and see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. If you hear back from anyone, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back from anyone.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course—I’ll keep an eye out for any tools or spare parts. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear—if you still need another pair of hands, I can swing by later and help out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira—that’d be appreciated. If you can swing by later, I can use the extra help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? It’s really coming together nicely—people are dropping off tools and spare parts over by the community hall. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Tess—thanks. I heard it’s got a nice turnout already, so I’m glad it’s coming together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it’s been a good turnout so far—folks really showed up with all sorts of useful stuff. I’ll let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just need help keeping the repair drive organized and making sure the basics are covered. If you can, start by checking what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check the supplies, but I still need to confirm the exact location for the repair drive—do you know if it’s at the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, the front porch should be right. If anything’s missing, just let me know and I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s now Sunday at the community center. I can use help setting up the tables and checking people in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can help set up the tables and check folks in. Just point me where to start, and I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Eli — could you start by setting up the tables near the main entrance, then help with check-in as folks arrive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard second-hand, but it sounds like the drop-off is by the community hall. If you hear anything new, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Nell—I’ll let you know if I hear any updates. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out too and head to the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly just the big stuff—if you can help with the urgent repairs, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I can start with the urgent repairs. What’s the biggest one you want me on first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: The leaky roof is the biggest one—if you can tackle that first, we’re in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely—once you bring the list, I’ll take a look in my shed and gather what I can. I may need a reminder, but I’m happy to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s for tools, spare parts, and repair supplies, with drop-offs by the community hall. I’ll keep spreading the word around the block too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks for spreading the word. Bring the list by when you can, and I’ll take another look in my shed for anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s this Saturday on the front porch, and I could really use a few helpers. If you can spare some time, come by and I’ll put you to work.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Actually, I heard it’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. I can help out there if you still need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thanks for the heads-up—Sunday at the community center works too. I still need the help, so please come by then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Just point me to the task and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll keep an eye out for any tools or spare parts. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rey—that helps a lot. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: The repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so that should be easier for me to plan around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—Sunday at the community center works for me. Let me know if you still need anything from me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo—I'm good for now, and I’ll check the school notices in case anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We still need a few hands for the repair drive, and I can cover anything else if needed. I’ll let you know what’s left to fix.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik—just send me what’s left to fix, and I’ll check what I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll send you the remaining fixes for the repair drive soon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, thanks for the reminder — has the time and drop-off spot been confirmed yet? I can bring something if needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I don’t think it’s fully confirmed yet—could you double-check the flyer and let me know the exact time and drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I’ll check the flyer and let you know the exact time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we have the start time and volunteer count yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not yet — I’m still waiting on the exact start time and volunteer count, but I’ll share it as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll help spread the word too.
